title: What If Earth Was a Cube?

hook.text:
WHAT IF EARTH
WAS A CUBE?

segments.text: What if Earth suddenly snapped into a cube?
Gravity still pulls toward the center, so each flat side becomes a giant bowl.
All the oceans rush downhill, to the middle of each face.
6 round seas, one on every side.
The air slides into the middle too.
Walk toward an edge, and the ground tilts up, steeper and steeper.
At the edge, you're climbing a 45-degree slope.
And the corners? Thousands of kilometers high, poking out into space, with no air.
Life could only survive in a ring around each sea.
Luckily, gravity always squeezes big planets back into a ball.
